CustomField.description: Running total paid against this instalment. NOTE: spec calls for a Roll-Up Summary from Payment, but Payment-to-Instalment is a Lookup (not Master-Detail) because one Payment can optionally apply to an Instalment while still being required to roll up to the Opportunity instead. Roll-Up Summary fields only work across Master-Detail, so this is a plain Currency field that the Stage 2 Payment-trigger Flow (US-28) will update instead.
CustomField.label: AM Amount Paid
